title: Agile Transformation
lead: Organisation-wide adoption of agile principles and ways of working — beyond teams, into leadership, governance and culture.

sections.heading: Overview
sections.body: Agile transformation is a fundamental shift in how an organisation plans, executes and governs work. It moves from plan-driven to value-driven delivery, from hierarchical to collaborative, and from project-based to product-based. True agile transformation requires changes in organisation design, leadership behaviour, processes and tooling.

sections.heading: ITOM Perspective
sections.body: Agile transformation is one of the most common ITOM use cases. It affects all dimensions of the operating model: organisation structure (cross-functional teams), processes (continuous delivery, retrospectives), people (new roles, skills and behaviours), technology (DevOps platforms), and governance (OKRs, lean portfolio management).

items.desc: Applying agile principles beyond individual teams — SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model.
Organising around stable product teams rather than temporary projects.
Value-driven investment and prioritisation at the portfolio level.
The behavioural shifts required — psychological safety, transparency, continuous improvement.
Managing the human side of the transformation using structured approaches.
